title: Tool call arguments structure inconsistent — extra nesting added in certain cases
documented_symptom: HTTP 200 tool_calls with arguments wrapped as {arguments:{...}, name:ToolName} when a parameter is named name; working case uses parameter city and returns {city:...}
expected_behavioral_invariant: tool_calls[].function.arguments JSON object equals only the declared parameters object — no extra top-level arguments or tool-name wrapper
why_executable: Local Ollama /v1/chat/completions is up; llama3.2:3b is the only installed model and already produces structured tool_calls on this host. Issue contrast is schema/prompt shape (ExtractName vs ExtractCity), not a GPU-only feature.
